assumptions: One stateless request, fixed full transcript and output atoms; three supported and two rejected input classes, nine canonical outcomes. Refusal-only empty output has two billed output tokens in this case. Real strings, media bytes and parallel tool call grouping are checked by implementation tests, not symbolically proved.

Canonical authentication, billing, provider truth, native authority, HTTP delivery and cancellation implementation correctness remain outside this adapter model. Tests control those external ports; one integration case runs the actual OpenAI SDK.
Unsupported items and parameters are explicitly refused before native/canonical effects. Stored responses, background operation, streaming and hosted tools are not implemented by this route.
Eventual completion requires fair local steps and eventual provider completion or failure. A hung provider can remain pending; unconditional completion has a checked counterexample.
Finite models and selected executable tests do not establish whole-backend coverage or TypeScript refinement.
Response identity allocation relies on the platform UUID generator; same-clock request separation has an actual SDK regression, not a proof of random uniqueness.
bounds.progress: Conditional progress only; unconditional completion is checked false.
